agent: Claude Code (CLAUDE.md, this repository) — D18: remove AGENTIC, fold it into SKILL/PROCESS (schema + model + validator + fixtures)
summary_for_principal: Built what we settled on: the format now has five ways a Tool's work gets done, not six. A step following one set of written instructions, with optional bounded discretion, is a SKILL. A step that's really a whole workflow of its own — either a separately published one, or a private one belonging only to this Tool — is a PROCESS. AGENTIC is gone; it never earned a separate identity once we agreed it wasn't about free choice. Every real AI-judgment step in the test corpus (research, interrogation, recommendation, review) is a one-word change from AGENTIC to SKILL and behaves identically. Added the actual ability to declare a private, inline workflow (no separate name or version) as a real, working, tested feature — including two tests that specifically try to break its one rule (must name exactly one of "call this named workflow" or "here's a private one") and get refused correctly. This is schema, data-model and rulebook work only; the running engine doesn't yet know how to execute a workflow-as-a-step in either form (that's still future work), but it's now something you can correctly write down and have checked before that work starts. Full suite: 310 tests pass.
